newsitem.title: USA: Rowan sees well termination hurting Q1.
newsitem.headline: Rowan sees well termination hurting Q1.

text.p: Rowan Cos Inc said it and Pennzoil Co's Production & Exporation Co unit have agreed to terminate a contract for a well being drilled offshore Louisiana in a move that will hurt Rowan's first quarter earnings by about $20 million.
Rowan earned $6.3 million or $0.03 per share in last year's first quarter.

"It was time to fold 'em. The drilling team on the Rowan-Juneau gave it their best for 477 days, but after a series of underground blowouts, stuck pipe, lost holes and an uncontrollable, unstable heaving shale section, it became apparent that we would be unable to reach the contract depth," said Rowan chairman C.R. Palmer.
